intent.proves: No page permission points at a page that does not exist.
intent.scope: all page permission rows; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 up.PermissionKey FROM UnifiedPermission up WHERE up.PermissionName = N'Page' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Page p WHERE CAST(p.PageId AS nvarchar(20)) = up.PermissionKey)
